verdict.rationale: Unit's docs confirm ACH is supported as part of its money-movement capabilities, but there is no evidence of same-day ACH windows, or of returns/NOCs/reversals modeled as first-class objects with webhooks — the API/OpenAPI probes even 404, showing no detailed API reference was found. missing for 10: documented ACH return/NOC/reversal objects, same-day ACH windows, webhook event schemas, and any API reference confirming these as first-class objects.
